_note: Which retirement entries take one limit for the employee's year rather than one per payment: voluntary retirement, "any amount received … in accordance with any scheme or schemes of voluntary retirement … to the extent such amount does not exceed five lakh rupees" (1961 s.10(10C); 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 12; sources/2026-10-18-retirement-employers.md) — one limit for the employee, the year's payments together in the order entered (D-227). The row states the reach only; the limit is RET-VOLUNTARY-RETIREMENT's. Provisions, introduction and provenance are RET-VOLUNTARY-RETIREMENT's (W-155a). Every regime.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2023 (8 of 2023), s.52 — the new regime of s.115BAC(1A), whose s.115BAC(2)(i) does not exclude s.10(10) to (10C), so the entry applies in every regime
